discrepanze.comando: SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('sys_skill_families','sys_skill_categories','sys_skill_taxonomy_edges','sys_job_families','sys_skills','sys_job_roles','sys_tenant_blueprints','sys_surveys','sys_goals','sys_engagement_surveys','sys_organization_units','sys_process_kpi_templates','sys_organization_unit_kpi_templates')

SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='sys' AND table_name IN ('sys_skill_families','sys_skill_categories','sys_skill_taxonomy_edges','sys_job_families','sys_skills','sys_job_roles','sys_tenant_blueprints','sys_surveys','sys_goals','sys_engagement_surveys','sys_organization_units','sys_process_kpi_templates','sys_organization_unit_kpi_templates') AND (column_name ILIKE '%tenant%' OR column_name ILIKE '%global%')
